data.summary:
Agentic AI & GenAI Project Manager with 14+ years of BFSI technology and transformation experience,
specializing in AI-led quality engineering, Core Banking modernization, Digital Banking, software delivery,
test automation, data migration, and enterprise transformation.
Experienced in leading and coordinating Agentic AI / GenAI initiatives from problem identification and
requirements through solution design, AI-agent development, integration, evaluation, deployment, and
production adoption.
Designed and delivered an Agentic AI framework comprising 7 AI agents that transforms BRDs and
business requirements into Test Strategy, Test Plans, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, Automation Code, Execution,
MCP/tool integration, Self-Healing, Root Cause Analysis, Test Coverage, and Test Generation Dashboards.
Integrated approximately ~2 TB of enterprise/client knowledge into RAG-enabled AI workflows and
achieved approximately 82% reduction in defects and 70% savings in manual review effort through AI-
driven quality engineering and Human-in-the-Loop optimization.
Brings 4 years of Fiserv DNA and Q2 experience across Core Banking and Digital Banking transformation,
implementation, modernization, upgrades, integrations, and data migrations. Supported 6 banking
transformation/migration projects, large cross-functional teams of 70–142 professionals, and deployments
across 3 environments.
Strong ability to bridge Business, Product, AI, Engineering, QA, Data, Architecture, Operations, and Client
stakeholders, translating complex banking problems into practical, measurable Agentic AI solutions.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
ValueMomentum
Agentic AI & GenAI Project Manager | BFSI Transformation Client: America First Credit Union, USA |
[DATES]
Agentic AI Project Leadership
Lead and coordinate Agentic AI / GenAI initiatives focused on software quality engineering, banking
transformation, automation, defect prevention, and delivery optimization.
Drive AI initiatives across the lifecycle from business problem identification → requirements → solution
design → agent architecture → development → integration → evaluation → deployment → adoption.
Designed and implemented an Agentic AI quality engineering framework connecting BRDs and business
requirements with automated test planning, test generation, execution, analysis, and reporting.
Led the development of 7 specialized AI agents supporting requirements analysis, Test Strategy, Test
Planning, Test Scenario generation, Test Case generation, Automation Code generation, execution
analysis, Self-Healing, RCA, coverage, and reporting.
Established the end-to-end AI workflow:
BRD → Requirement Analysis → Test Strategy → Test Plan → Test Scenarios → Test Cases →
Automation Code → Execution → MCP/Tools → Self-Healing → RCA → Test Coverage →
Evaluation → Dashboard
Coordinated teams across AI Engineering, QA, Development, Architecture, Data, Business, Product,
DevOps, and Client stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of Agentic AI capabilities.
Defined project objectives, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, quality gates, risks, and acceptance
criteria for AI initiatives.
Coordinated AI solution development across React frontend, backend services, databases, RAG, agent
orchestration, model integration, tool connectivity, evaluation, observability, and deployment.
Facilitated technical and business discussions to translate complex banking problems into actionable AI
use cases.
Established Human-in-the-Loop governance, ensuring clients review critical exceptions and high-impact
decisions while AI agents handle repetitive analysis and validation.
AI Quality Engineering Transformation
Directed implementation of AI-assisted testing workflows capable of converting BRDs into Test Strategy,
Test Plans, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, and Automation Code.
Coordinated AI-generated automation assets including Feature Files, Page Object Models, Step
Definitions, and executable automation workflows.
Implemented AI-assisted test execution, failure analysis, self-healing automation, Root Cause Analysis,
and test coverage analysis.
Established AI-driven quality workflows to identify gaps between requirements, business rules, generated
tests, executed tests, and defects.
Developed test-generation and quality dashboards providing visibility into test creation, execution,
coverage, defects, AI evaluation, and quality metrics.
Coordinated AI evaluation activities using DeepEval and observability mechanisms to measure relevance,
groundedness, coverage, response quality, and agent performance.
RAG / Enterprise AI Knowledge
Led integration of approximately ~2 TB of enterprise/client knowledge into RAG-enabled Agentic AI
workflows.
Defined knowledge requirements and coordinated ingestion of BRDs, FSDs, functional specifications,
business rules, testing artifacts, and domain documentation.
Established RAG-based workflows to ensure AI-generated outputs are grounded in relevant enterprise and
banking knowledge.
Coordinated data-layer and conditional business-rule workflows controlling how information is retrieved,
validated, transferred, and consumed by AI agents.
MCP / Tool & System Integration
Coordinated integration of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-enabled workflows into Agentic AI
solutions.
Integrated AI workflows with enterprise tools including Git and Slack.
Coordinated integration across APIs, backend services, databases, data layers, enterprise applications, and
AI models.
Evaluated cloud-hosted and local model approaches based on project requirements including security,
performance, scalability, latency, and cost.
AI Deployment & Delivery
Coordinated containerization and deployment of AI components using Docker.
Supported deployment across 3 environments and multiple project lifecycles.
Coordinated release readiness, environment validation, testing, defect closure, stakeholder sign-off, and
production deployment.
Worked with technical teams to identify deployment dependencies and manage environment-related risks.
Supported transition of AI solutions from development and experimentation into controlled enterprise
delivery.

Supported Fiserv DNA → Q2 Core/Digital Banking transformation and migration initiatives.
Coordinated business and technology activities across Online Banking, Commercial Banking, Mobile
Banking, Domestic Payments, and International Payments.
Managed requirements, integration dependencies, data migration activities, testing, defect resolution, and
production readiness.
Coordinated source-to-target data validation, reconciliation, business-rule validation, and migration
testing.
Supported SIT/UAT and production deployment activities across complex banking transformation
programs.
Coordinated cross-functional teams to resolve functional, integration, data, and environment-related
issues.
Orchestrated knowledge-sharing sessions and technical workshops to upskill cross-functional teams
in GenAI solution adoption, fostering enterprise-wide AI competency and accelerating innovation

Instituted a standardized AI change management process, enabling traceable updates to over 500
model artifacts annually while reducing update-related errors by 40%.
